extracted.name: 151. Banana Chocolate Chiffon
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp lime juice or 1/2 tsp cream of tartar
instruction_lines: Melted the butter. Mashed all bananas.
Ingredients A: Whisk egg yolks and sugar for about 2 minutes.
Add mashed bananas, vanilla, milk, and melted butter. Mix well.
Add the flour and mix until combined. Set aside.
Ingredients B: Beat egg whites with lime juice and salt until foamy. Gradually add sugar in 3 additions, and beat until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold the meringue into the batter in batches (about 3 times) using a spatula. Use a folding technique so the batter doesn’t deflate.
Pour into an ungreased chiffon pan. Add the chocolate chips or chocolate button.
Bake at 160°C for about 60 minutes. Invert the pan after baking. Once cooled to room temperature, loosen the edges with a knife. Ready to served
